colors: authored sRGB hex; convert with materials.linearColor for standard linear-light PBR factors
notes: A JSON mesh-authoring master, not a GLB or embedded animation clip.
Runtime meshes are rebuilt with art/geometry.ts and the Babylon world adapter.
Rigid part leaf and door movement is applied around the authored local pivots.
Original V9 surface maps retained separately; nativeSurfaceGeometry supplies metre UVs; standard fixture GLBs embed their actual colour/normal maps.
No device or WebGL visual validation is implied by this export.

camera.note: Fit excludes decorative upper wall/plinth only. Preserve user zoom relative to this fit when the safe viewport changes; ordinary draw must not reset camera.

lighting.note: V9 analytic original room IBL plus stronger directional window light; exposure stays 1. Standard PBR fallback. No tone-map/exposure boost, bloom or dynamic reflection. Face fill includes only face skin/ink meshes; hair/cloth retain key/fill volume. Warm window key, restrained cool sky and a separate cool exterior fill; assess actual WebGL evidence for visual acceptance.

surfaceAssets.rights: Original procedural KeEv Games inputs. No third-party/ref-image pixels.
surfaceAssets.colourEncoding: sRGB colour maps; linear OpenGL tangent-space normals
surfaceAssets.projection: nativeSurfaceGeometry per-face metre UV. Timber repeat1/m; floor repeat1.10x2.20m; plaster1/m; linen16/m. Runtime levels timber.20/plaster.15/linen.13. Prior original masters retained.
